answer: Vested-latency escrow routes each identity's rewards into a per-identity lock released only after a glacier withdrawal delay and a three-endorsement ridge quorum drawn from distinct atlas branches. A newcomer must post a full bond, wait through the delay, and earn trust at one claim per epoch; abandoning early forfeits both bond and unvested balance. A coordinated ring fails because quorum seats count branches, not identities, so fake members cannot certify each other without burning separate bonds and waiting out the same delay.
